These primitives form a dual structure where Bayesian shrinkage stabilizes noisy estimates (EB), while Elo provides dynamic updating of latent strengths (Elo), and EPA offers granular performance attribution (WEPA). Failure modes include overfitting when sample sizes are low, or misalignment between observed and modeled outcomes. Dualities emerge in how each operator maps to either team-level or player-level evaluations, with shared assumptions of stationarity and ergodicity. The operators' interplay enables robust forecasting under uncertainty, especially in high-dimensional spaces such as NFL game states.
